title: feat: announce canonical model slugs
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds all 157 future canonical model IDs as working aliases now.
- Announces that the new IDs become canonical on **September 7, 2026 at 14:00 UTC**.
- Keeps every existing model ID working after the transition.
- Adds the temporary Models banner, detailed Enter announcement, README notice, and complete mapping in `MODEL_SLUGS.md`.
- Extends alias resolution tests to embeddings, realtime, and 3D models.

## Discord announcement copy

⚠️ **New model IDs are available now**

Publisher-qualified IDs such as `black-forest-labs/flux.1-schnell` work today. They will become the canonical model IDs on **September 7, 2026 at 14:00 UTC**.

Existing IDs will keep working after the transition, so current integrations do not need to change. New integrations can use the new IDs now.

Only the names are changing. Model behavior and pricing stay the same.

View all model ID changes: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/main/MODEL_SLUGS.md

## Checks

- 157 documented mappings resolve to the intended models and are present directly in their alias lists
- Enter alias tests: 467 passed
- Gen resolver and model-permission tests: 49 passed
- Enter and Gen type checks

gist.headline: The model garden gets signs
gist.blurb: 157 publisher-qualified model IDs are ready to use now, with a clear map for the September 7 handoff. The old paths remain open; the garden just has better labels.
gist.summary: Added 157 publisher-qualified canonical model ID aliases, such as `black-forest-labs/flux.1-schnell`, ahead of their September 7, 2026 at 14:00 UTC canonical-name transition, while preserving every existing model ID.
gist.impact: New integrations can use publisher-qualified IDs immediately, while existing apps keep resolving their current model IDs with unchanged model behavior and pricing after the transition.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model garden has gained clear wooden signposts: old short model-name paths and new publisher-qualified paths both lead to the same glowing model flowers. Polli acts as a warm guide with a tiny map and gardener hat, while a retro terminal displays a simple example canonical slug; the scene represents a planned naming migration without breaking existing routes.
